_comment: Lucky Paw Casino smoke run: lobby -> Slots -> three spins -> lobby. Use URL http://localhost:3004 (add ?fresh=1&seed=7 for a fresh, seeded run). Every scripted frame is one 1/60 s game step (window.advanceTime test clock in main.js). Each iteration starts and ends in the lobby, so --iterations N plays 3N spins; render_game_to_text().balance changes with every spin (10 chips a spin, wins paid back) and stats.games.slots.rounds counts them.

steps._comment: Reels stop, win (if any) counts up
Click skips a win banner if one is up (centre of the screen is the reels: harmless)
